mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, p.title AS title, p.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, (SELECT COALESCE(i.thumbnail_object_key, i.object_key) FROM community_image i WHERE i.post_id = p.id ORDER BY i.display_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail_key, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_image i2 WHERE i2.post_id = p.id) AS image_count, p.like_count AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS comment_count, p.view_count AS view_count, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at
JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = p.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'

sql.if: JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id

mapper.select:
SELECT , LEFT(p.content, 100) AS text, NULL AS liked_by_me FROM ( SELECT p.id FROM community_post p
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) picked JOIN community_post p ON p.id = picked.id
ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT p.id FROM community_post p WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , p.content AS text,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_post_like lk WHERE lk.post_id = p.id AND lk.member_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me
NULL AS liked_by_me
FROM community_post p
WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
